The engine itself holds no words for people: names and rules text belong to the app that shows the games. The demo page (`demo/page.js`, `demo/games.js`) and the command line (`src/cli.ts`, listed in `docs/strings-ja.md`) have Japanese words that have not yet been read by a native reader.
